/**** Isotope Filtering ****/
.isotope-item {

.isotope-hidden.isotope-item {

  z-index: 1;
}
/**** Isotope CSS3 transitions ****/
.isotope,
.isotope .isotope-item {
  -webkit-transition-duration: 0.8s;
  -moz-transition-duration: 0.8s;
  -ms-transition-duration: 0.8s;
  -o-transition-duration: 0.8s;
  transition-duration: 0.8s;
}
.isotope {
  -webkit-transition-property: height, width;
  -moz-transition-property: height, width;
  -ms-transition-property: height, width;
  -o-transition-property: height, width;
  transition-property: height, width;
}
.isotope .isotope-item {
  -webkit-transition-property: -webkit-transform, opacity;
  -moz-transition-property: -moz-transform, opacity;
  -ms-transition-property: -ms-transform, opacity;
  -o-transition-property: -o-transform, opacity;
  transition-property: transform, opacity;
}
/**** disabling Isotope CSS3 transitions ****/
.isotope.no-transition,
.isotope.no-transition .isotope-item,
.isotope .isotope-item.no-transition {
  -webkit-transition-duration: 0s;
  -moz-transition-duration: 0s;
  -ms-transition-duration: 0s;
  -o-transition-duration: 0s;
  transition-duration: 0s;
}

<p><strong>MISC: MOTÖRHEAD EXHIBITION OPENING</strong> Born from the British music scene of the mid-’70s, Motörhead bridged the gap between punk and heavy metal, ripping through the industry with frontman Lemmy Kilmister’s simple declaration to play fast and loud rock ’n’ roll. The “Ace of Spades” legends helped pave the way for speed metal and influenced rock’s evolution toward greater aggression, intensity and musical edge. The Punk Rock Museum honors the band and its iconic founder with its latest exhibition. Featuring handwritten pages of lyrics, historical photographs, and Lemmy’s bass and amp stack, the exhibit gives visitors a novel look at the gear, words and legacy of one of the heaviest bands of all time. <em>6 p.m., $49+, Punk Rock Museum, <a href="https://thepunkrockmuseum.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">thepunkrockmuseum.com</a>. –Gabriela Rodriguez</em></p>

<h2>Sunday, October 4</h2>

<p><strong>MUSIC: ROGER CLYNE AND THE PEACEMAKERS</strong><em> King of the Hill</em> fans might recognize Roger Clyne as the man who co-wrote the hit animated series’ theme song with the ’90s band The Refreshments. But his distinct blend of rock ’n’ roll, alt-country and mariachi has made him memorable in his own right. Clyne grew up on cattle ranches, but his heart remains firmly planted on the beaches of Mexico, a place he fell in love with during college.
